Kristaps Porzingis has been noticeable absence from Warriors training camp & preseason due to an undisclosed health issue 👀

Steve Kerr revealed that he still hasn’t seen him in person since training camp began. He described the situation as “definitely concerning”

Porzingis has dealt with reoccurring health issues in recent seasons, including a previously reported diagnosis of POTS. It is unknown whether his latest absence is related to that condition 

It appears likely that 40 year old Al Horford will start at center for Golden State

via Luca Evans, Joseph Dycus #nbanews #kristapsporzingis #gswarriors #nbaoffseason

The Timberwolves are placing a “leap of faith” in Jonathan Kuminga to be their starting power forward this season 😮

“Kuminga was a square peg in a round hole with the Golden State Warriors and never gained traction in 16 games with the Atlanta Hawks. Now the Minnesota Timberwolves are hoping he can be their starting power forward, a leap of faith similar to (Peyton) Watson — except with a dramatically smaller track record in the Wolves’ favor.”

Predict JK’s statline this season 👀

per John Hollinger #jonathankuminga #minnesotatimberwolves #nbanews #nbadeals

A woman has accused Dylan Harper’s girlfriend, JoJo Lacey, of cheating on Harper with her boyfriend… and that Harper knows about the alleged affair but is still in a relationship with Lacey 😳

The woman shared screenshots of Lacey secretly exchanging text messages with her boyfriend while still dating Harper. The woman took to social media to call out Lacey for allegedly communicating with her man behind Harper’s back, sparking renewed speculation about the couple’s relationship

The latest accusations come nearly two months after an August controversy in which both Harper and Lacey faced allegations of being unfaithful. During that incident, an Instagram user claimed that Harper had been entertaining other women, including allegedly spending time with another woman while training in Santa Barbara, California

Lacey also faced accusations that she had been exchanging direct messages with a football player since February. An alleged screen recording later circulated online appearing to show her communicating with another man

Harper publicly defended Lacey at the time commenting, “Let the jealous ones hate from afar.” His father, former NBA player Ron Harper, also dismissed the allegations, responding, “Go live your life.”

With another woman now accusing Lacey of messaging her boyfriend, the couple’s relationship has once again become a major topic of discussion online

#dylanharper #sanantoniospurs #nbanews #nbaoffseason

The Wizards are reportedly unlikely to offer Anthony Davis the 4-year, $275 million max extension he is eligible for due to Davis’ age & injury history 

Rich Paul is already assessing trade interest around the league and will continue to do so as the February trade deadline approaches 

The Warriors, Pistons, and Raptors were among the teams interested in Davis this offseason 

Which team should offer AD the max?

per Jake Fischer #anthonydavis #washingtonwizards #nbanews #nbatrades

Tyrese Haliburton is ACTIVE tonight for the first time since tearing his achilles in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals 🥹

Hali returns to his alma mater, Iowa State, for the Pacers’ preseason game against the Timberwolves 

To make it extra special, Hali bought every student-section ticket so that Cyclones fans can attend for free 🤝

per Scott Agness #tyresehaliburton #indianapacers #nbanews #nbaoffseason

Brandin Podziemski is reportedly seeking an extension in the $20M-$24M annual range 👀💸 

Podz has been Golden State’s best offensive player at times during Warriors training camp, according to reports 

The Warriors have until October 19 to sign him to a rookie-scale extension 

per Brett Siegel #brandinpodziemski #gswarriors #nbanews #nbaoffseason

Kyle Kuzma is getting flamed online for his ASSterclass performance in the Bucks’ preseason opener 😭

Kuz scored ONE point on 0/6 FG in 20 minutes of play 

Kuzma says not to worry though, it’s just preseason 🤷‍♂️

#kylekuzma #milwaukeebucks #nbanews #nbaoffseason

76ers big man Ariel Hukporti has torn his achilles & will be out for remainder of the season 🚨 

Hukporti was only 6 minutes into his Sixers tenure. He was helped off the floor by his former Knick teammates 

Prayers Up 🙏 

per The Athletic #arielhukporti #philadelphia76ers #nbanews #nbaoffseason

For the third consecutive year, Max Strus will miss the beginning of the season due to foot injury 🤕

🟨 2024 — missed multiple weeks due to a right ankle sprain
🟨 2025 — missed most of the season with a Jones fracture in his left foot
🟨 2026 — expected to miss multiple weeks with a partial plantar fascia tear

BRUTAL

#maxstrus #laclippers #nbanews #nbaoffseason #nbainjury

Anthony Edwards reveals he took nearly two months completely away from basketball this offseason to allow his knee to heal 👀

Edwards suffered a hyperextension on his left knee in the first round of the playoffs last season. The injury typically carries a multiple week absence, but Ant returned in just nine days

Edwards admits the time away was “super tough” and that he gained a significant amount of weight. After undergoing treatment this offseason, Ant says he’s lost the weight and is fully healthy 

via Heavy #anthonyedwards #minnesotatimberwolves #nbanews #nbaoffseason

Fans are criticizing Draymond Green for showing up to Warriors training camp out of shape 😬

Following the Warriors’ preseason opener, a video of Green speaking began circulating online, with fans questioning his conditioning & speculating that the 36 year old is out of shape 

Dray dropped 2 PTS, 2 REB, 2 AST, and 3 STL in 14 minutes 

via Luca Evans #draymondgreen #gswarriors #nbanews #2027nbaseason

Heat head coach Erik Spoelstra compared Giannis to Magic Johnson after last night’s preseason game 👀

“The size and the vision and his ability to put it on the numbers to shooters is really impressive... The way he’s played with the ball in his hands and delivering the ball, (Giannis) reminds all of us of a great big point guard that played for Pat (Riley) back in the 80s.”

Giannis dropped 9 PTS, 4 REB, and 7 AST in 14 MIN 

Thoughts?

#giannis #magicjohnson #miamiheat #nbanews #nbaoffseason
